name: 17211-mtbenchspec-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B (draft). The target repo is the standard ungated mirror of the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` -- same weights, a mirror and not a substitution.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1. One engine, one card.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params. Draft: EAGLE-1 head, one decoder layer at the same hidden size and vocabulary, max_position_embeddings 2048; its config says float16 but it inherits the target's dtype.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1, bounded at 400 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 20% by completion. One stream is the declared operating point.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn: `configs/data/mtbench-firstturn-80x5.jsonl`, the first turn of all 80 MT-Bench questions (question_id 81-160, all eight categories) cycled 5 times to the 400-request bound. Raw prompt tokens mean 65.7, min 12, p50 38, p90 187, max 349 (Llama-3.1 tokenizer, add_special_tokens=False); the chat template the backend applies adds exactly 10 tokens to every row. Output is capped at 256 tokens with EOS honoured (`ignore_eos: false`), greedy at temperature 0.0.
purpose: A single-user chat assistant answering short, varied questions with an 8B model and a draft model on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` is gated; NousResearch's repo is
# the standard ungated mirror of the same weights -- a mirror, not a substitution.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 2, "max_model_len": 2048}
max-model-len: 2048
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80

# NOT the default: the request file is 80 prompts cycled 5 times, so with prefix caching on four
# fifths of the run would prefill out of cache and stop describing the declared workload.
enable-prefix-caching: false
